sub_graphs.title: EIP-7805: Beacon State Fork Upgrade from Fulu
sub_graphs.description: Models the state transition during the fork from Fulu to EIP-7805, upgrading all 39 beacon state fields and setting the new fork version.

nodes.label: Beacon State at Fulu
nodes.description: The beacon chain is running Fulu consensus rules at the slot immediately before EIP7805_FORK_EPOCH

nodes.label: Check EIP-7805 Fork Epoch Condition
nodes.description: Evaluate whether current slot is the first slot of EIP7805_FORK_EPOCH (slot % SLOTS_PER_EPOCH == 0 and epoch matches)

nodes.label: Execute upgrade_to_eip7805
nodes.description: Perform irregular state change: copy all 39 Fulu state fields, update Fork object with EIP7805_FORK_VERSION (0x0a000000)

nodes.label: Beacon State at EIP-7805
nodes.description: The beacon chain is running EIP-7805 consensus rules with fork version 0x0a000000

nodes.label: Fork Condition Not Met
nodes.description: Current epoch does not match EIP7805_FORK_EPOCH; system continues in Fulu

edges.label: Epoch does not match; continue Fulu
State upgraded: fork version set to 0x0a000000

sub_graphs.title: EIP-7805: Fork Transition Integrity Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation requirements ensuring the fork transition preserves state integrity and correctly updates version identifiers.

nodes.label: Pre-Fork Fork Object
nodes.description: Fork object contains Fulu version as current_version

nodes.label: Validate Previous Version Set
nodes.description: Verify fork.previous_version is set to the Fulu fork version (pre-fork current_version)

nodes.label: Validate Current Version Set
nodes.description: Verify fork.current_version is set to EIP7805_FORK_VERSION (0x0a000000)

nodes.label: Validate Fork Epoch Field
nodes.description: Verify fork.epoch is set to the actual activation epoch

nodes.label: Validate All State Fields Preserved
nodes.description: Verify all 39 beacon state fields (validators, balances, committees, execution payload header, pending queues) transfer unchanged

nodes.label: Fork Integrity Confirmed
nodes.description: All fork transition checks pass; state continuity maintained

ambiguities.text: The specification does not define what new consensus behavior EIP-7805 introduces beyond the fork version change. The fork logic is purely mechanical state upgrade.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the actual EIP-7805 behavioral changes are defined in separate beacon-chain and p2p-interface specifications. This fork spec only handles the state transition mechanics.

ambiguities.text: EIP7805_FORK_EPOCH is set to the maximum uint64 value (18446744073709551615), marked as TBD.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: This is a placeholder sentinel value meaning the fork is not yet scheduled. The actual epoch will be set before mainnet deployment.

implicit_assumptions.description: All validator client implementations will correctly implement the upgrade_to_eip7805 function, producing identical post-fork state roots.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Divergent implementations would cause a consensus split at the fork boundary, potentially partitioning the network.

implicit_assumptions.description: The Fulu fork has been successfully activated before EIP-7805, as this fork upgrades from Fulu state.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Attempting to apply upgrade_to_eip7805 on a non-Fulu state would produce an invalid post-fork state.
